question: Fine-tune stt_en_conformer_ctc_small on my dataset at ./data/mydata for 5 epochs.
ground_truth: Skill should verify GPU and Docker image first, then launch with dataset=./data/mydata, model=stt_en_conformer_ctc_small, max_epochs=5.
expected_behavior: Run nvidia-smi and docker images check before any training command.
Pass dataset path, model name, and epoch count as arguments to run_an4_finetune.sh.
Show the Config block confirming all three arguments resolved correctly.
Docker run includes --gpus all, correct -v mounts, and Hydra overrides.

question: Run 2 epochs of fine-tuning with stt_en_conformer_ctc_medium on ./data/an4.

expected_behavior: max_epochs=2 passed to trainer.max_epochs Hydra override.
